attrs.evidence: The round's result, and it is about the factory rather than the product. INV-R6.1 and a concurrent INV-R7 Embodiment round were written into one working tree at the same time, both branching from INV-R6. The R6.1 receipt then claimed ONE parent and ONE operation over a state containing two, and disclosed the ambiguity in prose. That disclosure was honest and insufficient: a transition receipt exists to identify an exact parent, an exact operation and an exact successor, and one that cannot is byte-consistent with a history that did not happen. This is the C10 shape at transition scope — two descriptions of what happened, diverging. The discipline is database serializability applied to recursive self-improvement: read parent P, work against an isolated snapshot of P, verify canonical HEAD is still P before promoting, and on drift abort, rebase, or record an explicit two-parent merge. LOCALLY VALID CONCURRENT IMPROVEMENTS DO NOT AUTOMATICALLY COMPOSE INTO AN HONESTLY IDENTIFIED GLOBAL SUCCESSOR. AT INV-R8-RECOVERY: the counterexample is preserved rather than repaired. INV-R6.1 and INV-R6.2 keep their bytes and are QUARANTINED — never an ancestor of the canonical head — and the canonical head is one recovery_replay whose single parent is the verified INV-R6. Preserving bad history does not require continuing to build on it.
attrs.gap: THE ENFORCEMENT HALF NOW EXISTS AND HAS BEEN USED EXACTLY ONCE. scripts/factory-station.mjs opens an isolated worktree at the canonical head, and promotes with `git update-ref <ref> <new> <old>`, which advances the ref only if it still holds the expected parent OID. INV-R8-RECOVERY is the first round promoted through it. WHAT IS STILL NOT TRUE: the station cannot bind a session that never calls it. The canonical state is the REF, not the shared directory, and a session writing the directory is not promoting anything — but it is also not refused. Measured during this round: at 17:17 on 2026-08-24 a third concurrent session rewrote mosaic/embodiment.json in the shared tree with no transition at all, and the head receipt's digest for that path stopped reproducing. `factory-station.mjs verify --worktree` reports such a divergence in one line; it does not prevent it. The claim also remains DECLARED because one promotion is not "every promoted round".

attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6's audit of INV-R6.1. Database serializability and optimistic concurrency control; the compare-and-swap discipline of a distributed version-control push.
attrs.statement: Every promoted round is derivable from the exact parent receipt it names; a canonical child may not silently contain edits from an unrecorded sibling branch.
